function.text: ERF encodes ETS domain-containing transcription factor ERF. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific and DNA-binding transcription repressor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific. It participates in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to craniosynostosis 4 (autosomal dominant); Chitayat syndrome (autosomal dominant).
